name: Octree Ray Traversal
aliases: Ray Traversal of Octree Nodes — Mid-plane Intersection Traversal
definition: An algorithm to find all octants in a pointer-based octree that intersect with a given ray, returning them sorted by distance (closest first). It uses parametric ray representation (t-values) to traverse the octree structure efficiently.
summary: Octree Ray Traversal is an algorithm that efficiently finds all octants intersecting a ray by computing mid-plane intersections to determine the exact traversal sequence of child octants.
